summary: Monroe Capital Income Plus Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) reporting that its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders was convened and adjourned due to lack of quorum. The meeting was rescheduled to July 28, 2026, with polls remaining open and no change to the record date of April 13, 2026. This is a routine procedural adjournment notice reflecting a quorum shortfall and does not involve any corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, activism, or restructuring. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are present.
